text: Final categorization: EXCLUDED (Justification: The paper's primary objective is to assess the potential impacts of hydropower development on biodiversity and forests, not to conduct or focus on land-use/land-cover (LULC) prediction. While it uses land-cover data and projects forest loss under two dam-building scenarios, this is an input for a species-area extinction model, not the core research aim. The study does not implement a national-scale LULC prediction model, generate spatially explicit LULC projection maps, or report quantitative accuracy metrics for LULC prediction. Its focus is ecological impact assessment.)
